svg.title: Conservation Officer — separate olive lower rocker
svg.desc: Clean vector reconstruction from visible artifact references; no photograph tracing, source textures or embedded raster. Natural outlined replacement fonts approximate embroidered alphabets. Exact stitch anatomy, manufacturing dimensions and calibrated thread colors remain unverified. Whole-master source placement uses uniform scale; the photograph is not used to distort separate border or emblem components. This upward-facing U-shaped lower strip is a separate object, with a different cut from the standard upper detached rocker.
